verdict.rationale: Delaware's eCorp franchise-tax and annual-report portal, its only mandatory-online filing, starts from a Business Entity File Number rather than an account login. A saved session ID is optional, and the page links a name search for founders who don't know their file number. missing for 10: an account-free online path for formation itself (forms are fillable PDFs submitted via upload, fax, or mail), independent hands-on corroboration that the flow completes without an account (the entry page also has an image CAPTCHA that was not tested).

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path

citations.quote: Please enter your Business Entity File Number below to start filing your Annual Report or Pay Taxes
Please also enter your 15 digit saved session ID number below (only if you have previously saved a session)
Need your business entity number? Search for your business by name
